blocks.task_summary: Find p and q given f(x)=2x^4-6x^3+px^2+qx-2, (x-1) is a factor, and remainder when divided by (x-3) is -2.
method_path: Form two linear equations in p and q
Solve simultaneously for p and q
accepted_alternatives: Use synthetic or long division to find remainders, then form equations and solve simultaneously.

evidence.basis: EITHER use of the remainder or factor theorem (M1) f(1)=0 OR f(3)=-2 ... (A1) ... (A1) ... solving simultaneously their two equations in p and q (M1) p=-3, q=9 A1
